query:
DELETE t1 FROM training_schedules t1
INNER JOIN training_schedules t2 
WHERE t1.id > t2.id 
  AND DATE(t1.training_date) = DATE(t2.training_date)
  AND t1.venue = t2.venue 
  AND t1.schedule_day = t2.schedule_day 
  AND t1.schedule_time = t2.schedule_time;
